pool.text: Construction began on the third railway line connecting Cairo to Luxor.
The village was established when the old Aswan Dam was built.
The dam structure was raised to impound water during the Nile flood season.
The Egyptian Chemical Industries Company, known as KIMA, was established by government decision.
Aga Khan III, associated with the Aswan mausoleum, died in this year.
The mausoleum tomb was inspired by the design of Fatimid Egyptian tombs.
The facility near the city began operating as part of the Aswan Air Base.
The construction of the Aswan High Dam lasted until this year.
The construction of the Aswan Bridge began, leading to completion later.
A museum dedicated to Nubian culture, heritage, and civilization was inaugurated.
The Aswan branch of the Misr Public Library was inaugurated and opened.
The church dedicated to Archangel Michael was consecrated in this specific year.
Archaeologists excavated petroglyphic engravings from Nag el-Hamdulab featuring a boat procession and symbolism.
The museum located on a large area was opened to visitors.
Aswan joined the UNESCO Global Network of Learning Cities in this specific year.
The annual Aswan International Women's Film Festival was established as a premier event.
The Egyptian Ministry of Antiquities announced the discovery of a Roman emperor bust head.
A sandstone sphinx statue was discovered at the temple of Kom Ombo.
Archaeologists discovered 35 mummified remains of Egyptians in a tomb located in Aswan.
An archaeological expedition uncovered submerged rock carvings and miniature royal images in the Nile.
